description:
List the visual styles Higgsfield Genjutsu Restyle can apply (nothing is charged).

Each item has id, name (English), name_ru and preview_url. Pass the chosen id as preset_id to
estimate_higgsfield_restyle / create_higgsfield_restyle. The list is Higgsfield's current one;
source says live, cache or fallback (our snapshot when Higgsfield did not answer).
name: list_higgsfield_restyle_styles
